title: ForEach Expansion
description: A forEach directive stamps multiple copies of an element. Can be a string referencing a named iteration group, or an inline map with 'as' (variable name) and 'in' (list of values). Stamped copies get IDs in the format 'originalId.value'. Use ${each.<as>} to reference the iteration variable.

oneOf.description: Reference to a named iteration group defined in the 'iterations' section.

as.description: The iteration variable name, referenced as ${each.<as>}.

in.description: List of values to iterate over. Values may contain ${prefix.name} variable references.
